about: thm-mi on the product of two subsystems: demand the first answerable, forbid the state to exceed the second.
The conflict is H(X), the retreat H(X|Y), and the premium of planning their difference — the mutual information.
Each factor is a chain, so neither factor prices anything on its own.

cases.name: independent — the premium of planning is nothing
a copy — the premium is the whole of X
noisy — the premium is what Y says about X
